# SCENE｜Red Velvet Hall
⟦BG|bg_c01s01|Red Velvet Hall⟧
⟦TIME|New York · Night 1⟧
旁白：Heavy red velvet curtains shut out the sound of the rain. The moment you step into the hall, five men stop talking almost at once. The air smells faintly of cedar and leather. Adrian stands two steps from the door, deliberately leaving you a way out. His blue-gray eyes watch you quietly—neither pressing closer nor backing away. On the table lie a soft red ribbon, a black blindfold, and a blank card.
Adrian：“You can sit down, or you can leave right now. Tonight, only what you agree to happens. No defaults. No assumptions.”
Dante：“He's rarely this polite. Usually by now he's already assigning seats.”
Sebastian：“If you'd like us to show you first how we ask and how we stop, we can. I'm willing.”
Kai：“All five of us are here, but you don't owe anyone an explanation for your choices. If you only want to talk to one of us, just say so.”
Julian：“Let me ask one thing first: who do you want close? Who should keep their distance? You can change that anytime.”
Adrian：“I want to know you. But I won't treat this invitation as permission. You say stop, I stop. You say back off, I back off.”
旁白：His voice is low and steady, carrying a deliberately restrained need for control. You can feel him waiting for your first word, like waiting for a signal.

⟦BG|bg_c01s02|The Rule Room⟧
⟦TIME|New York · Night 1⟧
旁白：The small room next door is quiet, the light dimmer than the hall. Julian lays out cards reading “Continue,” “Pause,” and “End.” Adrian takes off his watch and sets it on the table, revealing a faint old mark on the inside of his wrist—not a wound, more like the memory of something worn there for a long time. He waits for you to speak, his fingers in no hurry to touch any of the props.
Julian：“The pause word here is ‘Yellow,’ and the stop word is ‘Red.’ You can also just say ‘stop,’ ‘I don't want to,’ or ‘enough.’ We'll understand.”
Adrian：“We're only negotiating this one small stretch of tonight. Agreeing to this minute doesn't mean agreeing to the next.”
Julian：“If you're not sure, we don't touch. Not being sure is an answer in itself.”
Adrian：“Do you want me to lead, or do you want to give the orders? I'm ready for either.”
Julian：“Either of us can change our mind. No punishment, and nobody says ‘you're killing the mood.’”
Adrian：“If you say no, any disappointment is mine to handle. I won't turn it into your responsibility.”
旁白：His gaze is direct, carrying a restraint you could almost touch. The air seems a little warmer.
旁白：Your distance preference controls whether Adrian comes closer, stays, or steps back; you can end it anytime. His leather shoes make almost no sound on the carpet.
Adrian：“I can wait. You don't have to decide now. Tell me where you want me to stop.”

旁白：Adrian lays a soft red ribbon on the table and first wraps it around his own wrist to demonstrate. It rests against his skin, left deliberately loose, the end hanging into his palm—one light tug and it comes completely free. He looks up at you, his voice a little lower than before:
Adrian：“You can let me lead you one step, or let me follow you. Which do you want to try first?”
旁白：If you're willing, he asks first: “May I touch your wrist? Just this once.” Once you answer clearly, he supports the back of your hand; his fingertips run warm and he moves slowly. The ribbon brushes lightly as it wraps around, and he places the end in your palm—you can pull it loose yourself at any moment.
旁白：He asks, “Closer now, or stay right here?” If you let him closer, he stops at a distance where you can still breathe and decide again. You can almost feel his breath, but he doesn't cross the line you've set. A kiss still needs a clear yes from both of you again; he won't guess.
旁白：If you ask him to wear it instead, he raises his wrist, palm up, and waits seriously for your instruction, with a focus in his eyes that's almost obedient.
